definition: live coal.
example_en: The live coal in the hearth was still burning red.

definition: a stretch of rising land at the edge of a body of water, esp. a river.
example: ಬೆಸ್ತರು ನದಿಯ ಕಡದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಲೆ ಒಣಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The fishermen dried the nets on the rising bank of the river.

definition: a tribe whose main livelihood was from animal husbandry.
example_en: The people of the Kadugolla tribe live by rearing animals.

definition: strong; vehement; mighty; powerful.
example_en: Everyone was astonished by his mighty strength.

definition: a man lacking common sense and normal intelligence; a stupid fellow.
example: ಆ ಪೆಂಗು ಯಾವ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನೂ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That stupid fellow did not do any work properly.

definition: intense anger; ire.
example_en: Intense anger arose in his mind due to the insult.

definition: administration through officials who rigidly follow regulations.
example_en: There is a lot of rigid bureaucratic administration in that department.

definition: the large deer Cervus unicolour, with coarse hair, a short, erectile mane and three-pointed antlers; sambar.
example_en: A sambar deer was running in the forest.

definition: the tree Syzygium zeylanicum ( = Eugenia zeylanica) of Myrtaceae family; Ceylon black plum tree.
example_en: The Ceylon black plum tree grows in the hilly region.

definition: a report of a recent event; intelligence; information; news.
example_en: The news of the war spread through the whole town.

definition: a house, tent, hut, etc. where one stays temporarily; a place of sojourn.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕರು ಊರ ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಂದು ಬಿಡುವನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಂಗಿದರು.
example_en: The travellers stayed temporarily in a sojourn outside the town.

definition: a woman who makes and sells garlands of flowers.
example: ಆ ಪೂವಡಿಗಿತಿ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆಯೇ ಹೂ ಕೊಯ್ದು ಹಾರ ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: That flower-garland-making woman plucks flowers and makes garlands early in the morning.

definition: to gain strength, stamina or ability.
example_en: With good food the patient gained strength.

definition: the quality or fact of being broad, wide; breadth; width.
example_en: This river's breadth is very great.

definition: to cause to feel disgust; be sickening, repulsive or very distasteful to; to disgust.
example_en: That scene disgusted everyone.

definition: a device furnishing artificial light; a source of light; a lamp.
example_en: Grandmother lit a lamp in the corner of the house.

definition: a water-passage; a channel.
example_en: The channel overflowed with rainwater.

definition: to be enraged strongly.
example_en: When he was insulted, he became strongly enraged.

definition: a group of singers and music providers sitting in front or by the side of the stage, in a play or dance programme.
example: ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಮ್ಮೇಳ ರಂಗದ ಮುಂದೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಪಕ್ಕವಾದ್ಯ ನುಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: In the play, the musicians' group sat in front of the stage and played the accompanying music.

definition: a calf; a young cattle.
example_en: The calf of the cow was playing in the pasture.

definition: a room or hall having fine engravings on walls, roof etc.
example_en: We saw the fine engravings in the engraved hall of the palace.

definition: not directed; not guided.
example: ಆ ಯೋಜನೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಗುರಿಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಅನಿರ್ದೇಶಿತವಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: That plan remained undirected without a clear goal.

definition: the condition of being rich; wealthiness.
example_en: His wealthiness was increasing day by day.

definition: to join (oneself) with.
example_en: He joined the service organization to align himself with the poor.

definition: to undergo or feel difficulty; to be distressed.
example_en: As she climbed the hill, she felt distressed with breathlessness.

definition: a man who operates a boat; a boatman.
example: ನೀರ್ವಟಿಗ ದೋಣಿಯನ್ನು ನದಿಯ ಆಚೆ ದಡಕ್ಕೆ ತಂದನು.
example_en: The boatman brought the boat to the far bank of the river.

definition: (dial.) free and intimate behavior; absence of formality and ceremony; familiarity.
example_en: There was a lot of free, familiar behaviour between the two of them.

definition: of or belonging to which place or direction.
example_en: Which town are you from?

definition: three times.
example: ಅವನ ಸಂಪತ್ತು ಕೆಲವೇ ವರ್ಷಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂಮಡಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: His wealth became threefold in just a few years.

definition: the act of bringing several things or a number of pieces of the same thing together at one place and heaping them up; a piling.
example_en: The piling up of old books took place in the library.

definition: the special duties particular to each of the four orders, stages in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa.
example_en: Every Brahmana had to observe the duties of his stage of life.

definition: to make a dent by banging on.
example: ಕಲ್ಲಿನಿಂದ ಸೊಟ್ಟಗೆ ಬಡಿದು ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ತಗಡನ್ನು ಕಚ್ಚುಕೂಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He struck the iron sheet crookedly with a stone and made a dent in it.

definition: a leaping or jumping.
example: ಕ್ರೀಡಾಳು ಎತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ಸಮುದ್ವರ್ತನ ಮಾಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಬೆರಗುಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The athlete amazed everyone by leaping to a great height.

definition: a small mouse.
example_en: A small mouse ran across the kitchen.

definition: a younger brother.
example_en: His younger brother is serving in the army.

definition: a shop where textiles are sold.
example: ಅವಳು ಸೀರೆ ಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಜವಳಿ ಅಂಗಡಿಗೆ ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: She went to the textile shop to buy a sari.

definition: something supposedly seen or perceived by other than normal sight as in a dream, trance, etc. or supernaturally revealed by a divinity; a vision.
example_en: The ascetic had a vision of the goddess in his dream.

definition: the blunt end of a spear.
example_en: The hunter struck the boar with the blunt end of the spear.

definition: the act or fact of living together; a family-life.
example_en: Family life brought them happiness.

definition: an everlasting satisfaction.
example_en: An everlasting satisfaction resided in the saintly man's mind.

definition: a drug in the form of pill or capsule that induces sleep.
example_en: The doctor told him to take a sleeping pill.

definition: to make chattering, babbling sound; to talk foolishly or too much.
example_en: The child went along babbling something foolishly.

definition: a container for drinking, as a glass, small mug, etc.
example_en: A drinking mug had been kept on the table.

definition: to be able to manage, carry on, (esp. financially).
example_en: It is hard to manage the family on this salary.

definition: to be interwoven inside.
example_en: The threads of the cloth were well interwoven inside.

definition: a cup-shaped ear.
example_en: Everyone liked that child's cup-shaped ear.

definition: absence of self-restraint; inability to restrain one's desires; incontinence.
example_en: His lack of self-restraint ruined his health.

definition: a variety of rice.
example_en: The farmer sowed the maranel variety of rice in the field.

definition: a merchant whose business is small; a small vendor.
example: ಆ ಕಿರುವರದ ಬೀದಿಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಅಂಗಡಿ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That small vendor has set up a little shop on the roadside.

definition: to move one's palm on the head of another (as in showing one's affection, concern or in solacing, consoling, etc.).
example_en: The mother consoled the child by moving her palm on its head.

definition: outward impression; appearance; aspect.
example_en: An appearance of fear was seen on his face.

definition: to make wider or larger; to cause to expand; to dilate.
example_en: They dilated the balloon by filling it with air.

definition: a man who excavates; an excavator.
example_en: The excavator brought out ancient coins.

definition: a man who directs or plays a key role in, a play, cinema.
example_en: The director of this film is very famous.

definition: a sudden, unforeseen attack.
example_en: The enemies made a sudden, unforeseen attack on the village.

definition: the act of rubbing one object against another; a rubbing off.
example_en: The rubbing on the cloth removed the stain.

definition: a plan of one's proposed action or action undertaken.
example_en: They explained the action plan of the project in the meeting.

definition: the quality of being melodious or sweet.
example_en: The melodious sweetness of the cuckoo's call was pleasant to hear.

definition: a container, case or receptacle, usu. rectangular, of wood, metal, etc., and often with a hinged lid or removable cover; a box.
example_en: They arranged the clothes inside the box.

definition: a quivering, vibrating of a part of the body (involuntarily).
example: ಭಯದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಸುತ್ತ ಗಾತ್ರಸ್ಫುರಣ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Out of fear, a quivering arose around his eye.

definition: a wedge-like tool with a cutting edge at the end of the blade, made of steel, used for cutting or shaping stone; a chisel.
example_en: The sculptor carved the stone with a chisel.

definition: a man whose work or occupation is writing; a writer.
example: ಆ ಲೇಹಕ ದಿನವೂ ಹೊಸ ಕಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That writer writes new stories every day.

definition: a cardinal number, ten million; 1,00,00,000.
example: ಆ ಉದ್ಯಮಿಯ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಒಂದು ಕರೋಡ ಮೀರಿತು.
example_en: That businessman's wealth exceeded ten million.

definition: the mental disorder characterised by having apparent perception of sights that are not actually present or being inspired by false conceptions or fancy imaginations.
example_en: Because of that incident, madness appeared in him.

definition: a term used to proclaim "leave room for".
example: ಜನಸಂದಣಿಯ ನಡುವೆ ಸೆಂಬಳಿ ಎಂದು ಕೂಗಿ ದಾರಿ ಮಾಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: Amid the crowd he shouted for room and made his way through.

definition: a small water jug with a narrow mouth, usu. with a handle and a nozzle.
example_en: She drank water from the small jug.

definition: to emit spark or fire.
example_en: The firewood in the stove was throwing off sparks.

definition: the small protuberance on a breast or udder through which, in the female, the milk passes in suckling the young; the teat; the nipple.
example_en: The mother gave the nipple to the baby's mouth.

definition: a yogic posture of squating on the floor with the shanks crossing each other and the right foot resting on the left thigh and leftfoot on the right thigh.
example_en: The yogi sat in the palyankasana posture and meditated.

definition: actually; in fact.
example: ಅವನು ಅಂಜಸಾ ಆ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿಯೇ ಮುಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He actually finished doing that work.

definition: a kind of soft-bodied, parasitic worm that infects the intestine in humans.
example_en: A parasitic worm was found in the children's intestine.

definition: friendly or kind regard; good will; approval; liking.
example_en: Everyone had friendly regard for her.

definition: a man or boy whose work is tending, feeding, and currying horses; a groom.
example_en: That groom used to wash the horses every day.

definition: sound; noise.
example_en: A strange sound came from the forest.

definition: a printing house; a press.
example_en: They printed the book at the printing press in the town.

definition: a popular or very common treatment for diseases.
example_en: The villagers use the common remedy for cough.

definition: a slender needle like instrument used for etching; a etching-needle.
example: ಅವನು ಕೊರೆಸೂಜಿಯಿಂದ ತಾಮ್ರದ ಫಲಕದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆತ್ತಿದ.
example_en: He etched on the copper plate with an etching needle.

definition: the quality of a base, wicked or evil person.
example_en: Everyone knew about that man's base wickedness.

definition: the split seed leaves of dicotyledon plants (as of toor dal, bengal gram, etc.); split pulse.
example_en: They boiled the split pulse and made a curry for cooking.

definition: a grand banquet.
example_en: The king arranged a grand banquet for the guests.

definition: that which chiefly engages one's time; (one's) trade, profession or business; occupation.
example_en: Farming was his occupation.

definition: the tendency to running.
example: ಆ ಮಗುವಿನ ಓಡುಕುಳಿತನವನ್ನು ತಾಯಿ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother tried to correct the child's tendency to run.

definition: a herd of cows.
example_en: The cowherd had a large herd of cows.

definition: the part of a Kuṇṭe, a weeding implement, that connects the handle to the part which holds the shares.
example_en: Because the kuṇṭe's connecting part broke, the handle came apart.

definition: in a well knit state.
example_en: That basket has been woven in a well knit state.

definition: a valiant soldier.
example_en: The valiant soldier fought bravely on the battlefield.

definition: anxiety caused by fear, confusion, etc.
example_en: She felt anxious confusion on the day of the exam.

definition: the plant Brassica juncea of Brassicaceae family; mustard plant.
example_en: She ground the mustard plant finely and made the seasoning.

definition: a striking heavily the floor with one foot.
example: ಕೋಪದಿಂದ ಅವನು ಚಾಟುಗಾಲು ಹಾಕಿ ನೆಲವನ್ನು ಒದ್ದನು.
example_en: In anger, he stamped his foot heavily on the floor.

definition: the act of a person which has caused that person to be excommunicated from the caste or social class.
example_en: Because of his act that led to excommunication from the caste, his family too was humiliated.

definition: a little house of the crudest kind with a thatched roof; a hut.
example_en: The shepherds built a thatched hut on the hill.

definition: a lattice window.
example_en: Light was entering through the lattice window of the house.

definition: untimely, premature death.
example_en: He met with an untimely death in the accident.

definition: a sharp-pointed metal rod to drive and control elephants; a goad.
example_en: The mahout controlled the elephant with the goad.

definition: a forest; jungle; woods.
example_en: That forest was mostly destroyed by fire.

definition: a man, esp. a soldier, who is equipped with or uses a spear; a spearman.
example_en: The spearman raised his spear and swung it.

definition: a hemispherical roof; a dome.
example_en: The temple's dome was visible from far away.

definition: a small, short-handled axe; a hatchet.
example_en: The hunter cut the tree with his hatchet.

definition: the condition of being blind.
example_en: He became blind after the accident.

definition: to bestow something from pity, sympathy or compassion (used ironically also).
example_en: The rich man bestowed some money on the poor man out of pity.

definition: a coming around (something) once only; a single round.
example: ಎತ್ತು ಗಾಣದ ಸುತ್ತ ಒಂದು ಒರ್ಚುತ್ತು ತಿರುಗಿತು.
example_en: The bullock turned a single round around the oil press.

definition: Hanumanta or Bhīmasēna, as a son of the Wind-God.
example_en: Everyone praised the strength of Hanuman, the son of the Wind-God.

definition: disclosure and admission of guilt, sin, crime, offence etc. committed by oneself.
example: ಅವನು ಪೊಲೀಸರ ಮುಂದೆ ತನ್ನ ತಪ್ಪೊಪ್ಪಿಗೆ ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: He gave his confession of guilt before the police.

definition: the act or an instance of scratching.
example_en: His hand was wounded from the cat's scratching.

definition: he who is physically disabled; a maimed man or boy.
example: ಆ ಅಂಗವಿಕಲ ಹುಡುಗ ಚಿತ್ರ ಬಿಡಿಸುವುದರಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಪುಣ.
example_en: That physically disabled boy is skilled at drawing.

definition: a woman who writes or prepares a column, as in a newspaper or magazine; a columnist.
example: ಆ ಅಂಕಣಗಾತಿ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: That columnist writes about women's issues.

definition: the sacred book of Islam believed to contain revelations made to Mohammed by Allah; Koran.
example_en: Every Muslim reveres the Koran (kurānu) as sacred.

definition: a goddess that watches over or protects.
example_en: The protecting goddess of this village guards the people.

definition: a light spear thrown for distance as a test of strength and skill; a javelin.
example_en: The competitor threw the javelin far.

definition: a raised work, figure, print etc.; a figure or form that stands out on (a surface); an embossed work; embossment.
example_en: There is an embossed work on the temple wall.

definition: a stone structure.
example: ಆ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಬಳಿ ಪುರಾತನ ಕಲ್ಕಟ್ಟು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was an ancient stone structure near that temple.

definition: a manner, sort, variety that is particular or that distinguishes one from another.
example_en: This sari has its own distinct style.

definition: a light, small, portable, usu. circular cover for protection from rain or sun, consisting of a fabric held on a collapsible frame of thin ribs radiating from the top of a carrying stick or handle; an umbrella.
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದಾಗ ಅವನು ತಳೆ ಬಿಡಿಸಿ ಹಿಡಿದನು.
example_en: When it rained, he opened and held the umbrella.

definition: to hold a conversation; to talk.
example_en: The two friends were talking all through the night.

definition: a highly unsympathetic, uncompassionate person.
example_en: A highly unsympathetic person does not understand the sorrow of others.

definition: a kind of jaundice that exhausts the person greatly.
example_en: Afflicted by that exhausting jaundice, he became very weak.

definition: an action made in response to another action; reaction.
example: ಅವನ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ ಅವಳ ಪಡಿಮಾಟ ತಕ್ಷಣವೇ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: Her reaction to his question came immediately.

definition: the reign, protection and authority of a single sovereign (on a number of states).
example: ಆ ಚಕ್ರವರ್ತಿಯ ಏಕಚ್ಛತ್ರಚ್ಛಾಯೆ ಇಡೀ ಖಂಡವನ್ನು ಆವರಿಸಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That emperor's sole sovereignty covered the entire continent.

definition: the fact or condition of being bewildered due to incomprehensibility or unfamiliarity; bewilderment.
example_en: The new rules caused bewilderment among the people.

definition: that which is within reasonable limits; moderateness.
example: ಅವನ ಖರ್ಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಬಗೆಯ ಹಾಳಿತ ಕಂಡುಬಂತು.
example_en: A sense of moderation was seen in his spending.

definition: blown or blossomed slightly.
example_en: The flowers in the garden appeared slightly blossomed.

definition: a flower (as sunflower) having the ovary completely enclosed in the receptacle and the stamens, sepals, etc., situated above it; epigyny.
example: ಆ ಹೂವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಉಪರಿಶಲಾಕೆ ರಚನೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The epigynous structure is clearly seen in that flower.

definition: to fall into or to be trapped in, a deep pit or abyss.
example_en: The man walking in the dark fell into the deep pit.

definition: bad effect or result.
example_en: That decision led to a bad result.

definition: a jumping or leaping forward.
example_en: The rabbit jumped forward from the bush and ran away.

definition: the earth as the world of human beings.
example_en: Joy and sorrow are natural in the world of human beings.

definition: inflammation of the testis; orchitis.
example_en: His testis swelled up due to orchitis.

definition: to change one's form, nature, quality, etc.
example_en: As time passed, his nature changed.

definition: a begging for food, money or help.
example_en: The poor man begged for alms on the street.

definition: Varuṇa, the regent of western direction.
example_en: The fishermen worshipped Varuna, the regent of the western direction.

definition: the inner sanctuary of temples where the main idol is installed, and symbolically the birth place of the universe; sanctum sanctorum.
example_en: The priest lit a lamp in the sanctum sanctorum.

definition: to eat or drink a small amount of something; to taste.
example_en: She tasted a little to check if the dish was good.

definition: a literary composition consisting of both prose and verse.
example_en: That work is a good example of mixed prose-and-verse composition.

definition: a moving part (of any machine).
example_en: This machine's moving part is not moving properly.

definition: the nature, behaviour of an immigrant.
example_en: His immigrant nature was not yet apparent.

definition: the plant Ouratia angustifolia of Ochnaceae family.
example_en: The Ouratia angustifolia tree is used for medicine.

definition: a branch; any part or extension of a main body or system, esp. a) a division or part of a body of learning; b) a division of a family descending from a common ancestor; c) a subdivision of a family of languages.
example_en: Mathematics is a branch of science.

definition: to cause to rub; to cause to erase by rubbing.
example_en: He caused the old writing to be rubbed off the board.

definition: a person who indulges in dreaming or has visionary notion that is impractical; a daydreamer.
example: ಕನಸುಣಿಯಾದ ಅವಳು ಓದುವ ಬದಲು ಹಗಲುಗನಸು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: Being a daydreamer, she daydreams instead of studying.

definition: a smiling in an unnatural and affected manner; a crooked smile.
example: ಅವನ ಮುಸಿನಗು ಕಂಡು ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಶಯ ಬಂತು.
example_en: Seeing his crooked smile, she became suspicious.

definition: a man who tends gardens; a gardener.
example_en: The gardener waters the plants every morning.

definition: in an extraordinary manner; extraordinarily.
example_en: That artist painted an extraordinary picture.

definition: the direction or the point on a marineṛs compass, halfway between north and east; north-east.
example_en: The sun was rising in the north-east direction.

definition: a physical fight in which blows are exchanged.
example_en: A fight with blows exchanged took place between the two in the market.

definition: a fiery eye.
example_en: The children were scared seeing his fiery eyes.

definition: a variety of screw pine tree.
example_en: Screw pine bushes have grown on the river bank.

definition: to cut and turn up soil with a farm implement kuṇṭe to remove the weeds.
example_en: The labourers harrowed the paddy field and removed the weeds.

definition: an abdomen that has an accumulation of fluid in the peritoneal cavity; ascites.
example_en: The patient's abdomen swelled with ascites.

definition: something suffered; pain, distress; suffering.
example: ಆ ಘಟನೆಯಿಂದ ಆದ ಮಾತಾಮಾತ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಮರೆಯಲಾಗದ ದುಃಖ.
example_en: The suffering caused by that incident was an unforgettable sorrow for her.

definition: (the stomach muscles) to become withdrawn.
example_en: His stomach muscles became withdrawn out of fear.

definition: a shop having platforms, attached to the front wall on either side of the entrance.
example_en: They sell fruits and vegetables in the shop with platforms.

definition: the plant Vigna unguiculata (= V. catjang, = V. sinensis, = Dolichos sinensis, = D. catjang) of papilionaceae family; cowpea plant.
example_en: The farmer sowed the cowpea crop in the field.

definition: an acute shortage or absolute lack of food.
example_en: In the famine, an absolute lack of food afflicted the people.
The farmer cut the branches with the hooked knife.

definition: the distance from the bottom to the top.
example: ಗೋಡೆಯ ಊಚು ಸುಮಾರು ಹತ್ತು ಅಡಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The height of the wall from bottom to top was about ten feet.

example_en: The fried papad had a crisp, brittle texture.

definition: a work which is not or cannot be, carried on smoothly.
example_en: Because of the rain the work became difficult to carry on smoothly.

definition: transparent, colourless or slightly tinged quartz; a crystal.
example_en: The value of the crystal depends on its purity.

definition: the portion of the body just below the navel.
example_en: The wound was near the region below the navel.

definition: to put (a weapon as a sword) into a sheath of scabbard; to sheathe.
example: ಯೋಧನು ತನ್ನ ಕತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಭಂಡಾರಿಸಿ ಒರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: The warrior sheathed his sword and placed it in the scabbard.

definition: the gathering of secret information; secret intelligence; b) (collectively) persons or agency employed at this.
example_en: The king conducted secret intelligence gathering.

definition: a formal request in writing addressed to a judicial authority requesting for redressing, compensation etc.; a petition.
example_en: He submitted a petition to the court.

definition: (tear) to roll out of the eye.
example_en: Tears rolled out of her eyes.

definition: to cause to change the course (of another's motion); to turn; to deflect.
example_en: The driver deflected the vehicle to the right.

definition: a bailiff - a) an administrative official of a district, with power to collect taxes, b) an official charged in general with the execution of court orders, and who serves the court notices and who can seize a person to produce before the court, etc.
example_en: The bailiff informed the people of the court's order.

definition: a mark left by the shod or unshod foot, as in earth or sand; a footprint.
example_en: His footprint was seen on the mud path.

definition: an open porch or portico, usu. roofed, along the outside of a building; a verandah.
example: ಸಂಜೆಯ ಗಾಳಿ ಸೇವಿಸಲು ಅವರು ವರಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತರು.
example_en: They sat in the verandah to enjoy the evening breeze.

definition: to play or frolic in a boisterous lively way; to make merry.
example_en: The children are frolicking in the field.

definition: the condition of having actually occurred in history; authenticity of an event; historicity.
example_en: There is doubt about the historicity of this event.

definition: lack of discipline; indiscipline.
example_en: Undisciplined behaviour in the classroom cannot be tolerated.

definition: a response to an action; reaction.
example: ಅವನ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ ಅವಳ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಸೌಮ್ಯವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Her reaction to his question was very gentle.

definition: (dial.) scanty drizzling.
example_en: Scanty drizzling had been falling since morning.

definition: introversion - a) the state of being introverted; b) the state or tendency toward being wholly or predominantly concerned with and interested in one's own mental life.
example_en: His introversion kept him away from people.

definition: the jackal Canis aureus.
example_en: The jackal hunted the chickens.
